summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 27/27 pytest passed (10 new iteration-2 + 17 regression). Frontend: all critical mobile flows verified end-to-end on the public Expo web preview.

issues: Pre-existing: Image style.resizeMode deprecation warning. Cosmetic, non-blocking.

backend.dashboard_new_fields: GET /api/users/me/dashboard returns unread_notifications:int, tier{name,min,color,icon}, level_payouts{l1:400,l2:100,l3:50}. Bronze tier returned for team_size 0.
backend.multi_level_payouts: Verified S→A→4 directs: A wallet=₹400 (L1), S wallet=₹400 (4×L2 ₹100). Then E under D1 → S +₹50 L3 (=₹450), A +₹100 L2 (=₹500). transactions/me records level=2 and level=3 referral_payouts.
backend.notifications: Welcome on registration-fee, referral on direct signup, payout on credit, withdrawal request/approve/reject, order on checkout. unread_only=true filters; POST /api/notifications/me/read-all clears unread; dashboard.unread_notifications reflects count.
backend.cart_orders: POST /api/cart/add creates/increments; GET /api/cart returns items with product, line_total, total, count; remove + clear work; checkout 400 on empty/insufficient wallet, 200 on valid → order persisted with items array, wallet deducted, cart cleared, order notification created; GET /api/orders/me lists desc.
backend.regression: Admin login (ADMIN001), register, payment-fee idempotent (re-pay 400), 1+4 L1 payout still ₹400, withdrawal lock/refund-on-reject/approve+re-approve 400, admin endpoints (users/withdrawals/transactions/stats), products list — all green.

frontend.dashboard: BRONZE TIER pill renders, '0 in network' shown, L1 ₹400 / L2 ₹100 / L3 ₹50 chips visible, RECENT ACTIVITY section appears once notifications exist, dashboard-bell testID works.
frontend.notifications_screen: Tap bell → /notifications, lists 'Welcome to NetworkPay!' with timestamp; navigation back works.
frontend.shop: shop-cart-btn (top-right) shows count badge, product-add-{id} testIDs add items (verified count badge incremented to 2), bottom checkout bar 'shop-go-checkout' appears as 'N items in cart'.
frontend.cart: Item image + 'Classic Cotton Tote ₹499 × 2 ₹998' rendered, wallet vs total displayed, 'Insufficient wallet balance' warning, 'Pay with wallet' (cart-checkout testID) auto-disabled when wallet < total, cart-remove-{id} removes line and cart returns to empty state.
frontend.orders: Empty state 'No orders yet' renders with back button (orders-back).
frontend.register_to_payment_to_dashboard: Register with sponsor ADMIN001 → /payment → 'Pay ₹100 via UPI' click activates account → routes to /dashboard with valid data.

action_items: (Optional) Pay button on /payment is below the fold on small viewports (375x667) — consider sticky-bottom CTA for better mobile UX.
(Optional) Replace deprecated Image style.resizeMode with prop resizeMode (warning still present from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 760 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth.py, payment.py, withdrawals.py, cart_orders.py, notifications.py, admin.py).
DRY: cart_get and orders/checkout duplicate the 'enrich items with product + line_total' loop — extract a helper.
_credit_payout uses inc_dict mutation; if PAYOUT_PER_LEVEL or LEVEL_*_PAYOUT is float, wallet_balance ends up float. assertions in tests use ints which is fine but consider Decimal for currency.
BankUpdate.dict() / ProductCreate.dict() are pydantic v1 patterns; on v2 use model_dump() to silence DeprecationWarnings.
/api/notifications/me hard-caps at 100 — fine for now but no pagination cursor; document as known limitation.
Orders use embedded item snapshots (good for price-history), but no stock decrement on checkout — products.stock is never updated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical iteration-2 flows tested (dashboard tier+chips+bell+activity, /notifications, shop add+badge+checkout-bar, cart line/total/disabled-CTA/remove, orders empty state, register→pay→dashboard)

seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates ephemeral TEST_<uuid>@test.com users; cart/orders/notifications scoped to those users. UI test created shop_<uuid>@test.com sponsored by ADMIN001 (paid).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py + test_iteration2.py (run via `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`). Public base = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Useful UI testIDs: dashboard-bell, dashboard-copy-code, dashboard-share-code, shop-cart-btn, shop-go-checkout, product-add-{id}, cart-checkout, cart-remove-{id}, orders-back. Pay button on /payment screen needs scroll-into-view OR JS click fallback because it sits below the fold on 375x667. Bottom-tab buttons still lack testIDs (carry-over from iter 1).
rca_of_issue: No bugs surfaced. Multi-level payout chain confirmed: registration-fee handler walks sponsor → L2 → L3 sequentially, crediting fixed amounts; L1 only triggers on direct_referrals_count % 4 == 0. Notifications are idempotently inserted at every business event. Cart enriches items at GET-time so price changes are reflected, but checkout snapshots prices into the order record.
